proposals.evidence: Turner section1 explicitly gives Ningalam ēmand winter. The source final nd and ē vowel select the attested hemanta branch rather than the proposed lengthened *hemānta subsection. Existing manually collated source record and lect label preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Ningalam wāṇa and Shumashti nasal āṛa under āṇḍa; Grangali’s nasal r form agrees with the latter series. The heading discusses an *āṇḍra preform for regional forms, retained as historical uncertainty within this existing entry. Specific loan labels on other Pashai/Nuristani forms are not extended to these attestations. Existing manually collated source record and lect label preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Ningalam bōt and Shumashti bät cooked rice, alongside Gawri bat and Shina băt. The Grangali form matches this food family. The distinct stone homonym bōt is excluded. Existing manually collated source record and lect label preserved.
